newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER SCORES AGAIN FOR VELEZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER SCORES AGAIN FOR VELEZ.

text.p: Velez Sarsfield goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert scored his second goal of the Argentine Clausura championship in his team's 3-0 win at Independiente on Wednesday.
The Paraguayan international opened the scoring with a penalty in the 21st minute, adding to the penalty he scored against Newell's Old Boys 10 days ago on the opening day of the competition.
Wednesday's goal was his 13th for the club.

Goals from the more conventional source of strikers Martin Posse and Patricio Camps completed a convincing win for Velez and left veteran coach Cesar Luis Menotti's Independiente, supposedly one of the title favourites, one place off the bottom after three games.
